title: Open Community Hub Specification (OCHS)
description: Standardized schema for physical civic sharing hubs, safe exchange zones, and mutual aid deposit centers.

id.description: Globally unique identifier for the community hub, preferably an OCHS URN (urn:ochs:hub:<country>:<municipality>:<slug>) or UUIDv4.

name.description: Official or primary community venue name.

alternateNames.description: Alternative, translated, or colloquial names for the hub.

description.description: Detailed description of the exchange hub, ambient lighting, designated shelves, and public atmosphere.

location.description: Geographical location compliant with GeoJSON Point (RFC 7946) plus human postal address attributes.

coordinates.description: WGS 84 coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order as specified by RFC 7946 GeoJSON standard.

latitude.description: Convenience attribute for latitude in decimal degrees (-90 to +90).

longitude.description: Convenience attribute for longitude in decimal degrees (-180 to +180).

neighborhood.description: Hyperlocal neighborhood, quarter, or sub-district name (e.g., 'Downtown / Kvosin', 'Vesturbær').

countryCode.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 two-letter uppercase country code (e.g., 'IS').

osmOpeningHours.description: Standard OpenStreetMap opening_hours syntax string (e.g., 'Mo-Th 10:00-19:00; Fr 11:00-18:00; Sa-Su 13:00-17:00').

is24_7.description: Indicates whether the physical venue or exchange shelf is accessible 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

physicalExchangeCapacity.description: Physical capacity and storage constraints for item handovers and unattended deposits.

storageTier.description: Physical infrastructure tier available for holding items.

maxItemDimensionsCm.description: Maximum physical package dimensions in centimeters.

maxWeightKg.description: Maximum item weight accommodated in kilograms.

maxHoldDurationHours.description: Maximum time an item can remain on shelf or in locker before collection or community redistribution (default: 72 hours).

acceptsPerishables.description: Whether the hub accepts perishable food surplus.

refrigerationAvailable.description: Whether community food safe refrigeration is installed on premise.

verificationProtocol.description: Civic verification, staffing, lighting score, and cryptographic anchor details.

tier.description: Verification maturity tier of the hub.

lightingScore.description: Physical visibility and ambient lighting score on a scale from 1 (dim/obscure) to 5 (bright, monitored, highly visible civic atrium).

isStaffed.description: Whether civic or organizational staff are on duty during operating hours.

verificationHash.description: SHA-256 cryptographic attestation hash anchoring the hub coordinates and operating terms to a public ledger or merkle cycle.

verifierIdentity.description: Public name or DID of the verifying organization, municipal office, or civic body.

verifiedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp when verification was last audited.

activeIssueCount.description: Number of open crowd-reported issues (e.g., temporary closure, shelf overload, reduced lighting).

isIndoor.description: Whether the exchange area is sheltered indoors.

publicRestroom.description: Accessible public restrooms available on site.

publicWifi.description: Public community Wi-Fi accessible to neighbors.

transitNearby.description: Names of nearest bus stops, tram stations, or transit lines (e.g., 'Strætó lines 1, 3, 6, 11, 14 at Lækjartorg').

osmAlignment.description: OpenStreetMap mapping keys and entity cross-reference.

osmTags.description: Key-value mapping of standard OSM tags (e.g., 'amenity': 'library', 'opening_hours': '...').
